question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

He wore a ring with a family crest.

options.text: The phone started to ring during the meeting.
She showed him her engagement ring.
A ring of fire surrounded the camp.
They danced in a circle, forming a ring.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "The phone started to ring during the meeting."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ring"** in the given sentence refers to a circular band, typically made of metal, worn as ornamental jewelry or a symbol of marriage or family status. (अंगूठी)
 
 
 
• **Example:** He wore a ring with a family crest.
 
 
 
• In **Option 1**, the word "ring" is used as a homonym, meaning the sound produced by a bell or a phone. (घंटी की आवाज़)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The phone started to ring during the meeting.
 
 
 
• Homonyms are words that have the same spelling or pronunciation but different meanings. In this case, "ring" is a homonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: She showed him her engagement ring.** 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Refers to a circular band, usually made of precious metal, worn to signify an engagement. (सगाई की अंगूठी)
 
• **Example:** She showed him her engagement ring, which was studded with diamonds.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A ring of fire surrounded the camp.** 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Refers to a circular arrangement of fire or something resembling a ring. (आग का घेरा)
 
• **Example:** A ring of fire surrounded the camp, keeping the wild animals at bay.
 
 
 
 
• **Option 4: They danced in a circle, forming a ring.** 
 
 
• **Meaning:** Refers to a circular shape or formation. (गोल घेरा)
 
• **Example:** The children danced in a circle, forming a ring around the bonfire.
